preamble: The voiceless alveolo-palatal affricate [tɕ] is retracted to the retroflex affricate [ʈʂ]. In the history of Mandarin, the Middle Chinese 章 (Zhāng) series of palatal initials merged with the retroflex 知 and 莊 series, so Middle Chinese tɕ- surfaces as Mandarin zh- [ʈʂ].

examples.note: Zhengzhang reconstruction and Mandarin reading from Wiktionary.
Same 章-initial word; Mandarin zh- reflects the merger of the palatal and retroflex affricates.
